recipe: blend — uniform probability average of (text head, hidden-state head)
theta_note: Calibrated on the 99-task label-run with-handoff outcomes (matched-point rule); no evaluation-benchmark data in the selection.
route_rule: first fixer in cheap_order with P(solve) >= theta, else anchor

embedder.input: problem_statement plain text, no instruction prefix

hidden_state.source: replay-prefill final-token state, layer -4, pre-decode; captured by the calibration-run replay pipeline

sources: label-run fresh (solo labels) — states exist only here

inputs.embeddings_issue.npz: fit-time input (benchmark issue-text embeddings); not included in this release — the fitted head and its resume centroids are serialized in router_head.npz
inputs.embeddings_fresh.npz: fit-time input (label-run issue-text embeddings); not included in this release — the fitted head and its resume centroids are serialized in router_head.npz
inputs.hidden_states_fresh.npz: fit-time input (label-run searcher hidden states); not included in this release — the fitted head and its resume centroids are serialized in router_head.npz

firewall: Scope: the fitted parameters (head weights, resume centroids, feature recipe). The fit reads nothing derived from the evaluation benchmark and ran before any evaluation-set data existed.
